filtered_sql:
SELECT e.id,e.kind,e.namespace,e.value,e.locator,
bm25(search_fts) AS score,d.id AS document_id,search_fts.rowid AS fts_rowid
FROM search_fts CROSS JOIN entries e ON e.id=search_fts.entry_id
CROSS JOIN documents d ON d.id=search_fts.document_id WHERE search_fts MATCH ?1
AND e.conflicted=0 AND d.status IN ('generated_from_evidence','source_backed')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entry_evidence v WHERE v.entry_id=e.id AND v.status='source_backed')
AND (?2 IS NULL OR e.kind=?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR e.namespace=?3)
ORDER BY score,e.kind,e.namespace,e.value,search_fts.rowid LIMIT 10001
